say:1:1610532001:1.text: Gervan, Silven, what in the world were you two doing just now?! That's a mimic treant, one of the rarest magical species in this forest!
say:1:1610532001:1.source_cn: 格墨文，休，你们刚才在做什么！这是非常稀少的拟态魔树！

say:2:1610532002:1.text: I know you both are capable mages. Especially you, Gervan, I've always had high hopes for you.
say:2:1610532002:1.source_cn: 我知道你们两人一向优秀。尤其是你，格墨文，你的魔法天赋...

say:3:1610532003:1.text: You should know how dangerous that spell is! If anything went wrong, it could have wiped out this entire grove! Every plant and every creature with it!
say:3:1610532003:1.source_cn: 但你也应该很清楚，刚才那个魔法一旦失控会对这里造成多大...

say:4:1610532004:1.text: If you had even a shred of responsibility toward these creatures, you wouldn't have cast it so recklessly!
say:4:1610532004:1.source_cn: 你们但凡还有一点保护魔法生物的意识，就不该毫不犹豫地释放它！

say:6:1610532006:1.text: The lunarshard spell is only dangerous if the caster <style="highlight">loses control</style>, and that <style="highlight">won't happen to me</style>.

say:7:1610532007:1.text: Pride blinds even the finest mages, Gervan. Remember, nothing in magic is ever absolute.
say:7:1610532007:1.source_cn: 格墨文……魔法师需要对魔法保持敬畏，在神秘的魔力面前，...

say:8:1610532008:1.text: We remember your lessons, Professor. That's why we restrained our power and kept the spell's impact minimal.
say:8:1610532008:1.source_cn: 我和休都接受过您的教导，深知魔法的威能和这片密林的重要...

say:9:1610532009:1.text: See? The treant isn't dead, just weakened. It will recover in a few days. Our control was precise.
say:9:1610532009:1.source_cn: 看，它并没有死亡，只要经过几天休养就可以恢复如初。我们...

say:10:1610532010:1.text: Yes, Professor. We have practiced together many times. We know exactly what we're doing.
say:10:1610532010:1.source_cn: 是啊，赫普老师，我和格墨文配合过许多次，已经很熟悉了。...

say:11:1610532011:2.text: Then tell me, why were you hunting it in the first place?
say:11:1610532011:2.source_cn: 告诉我，你们为何要来狩猎它？

say:12:1610532012:1.text: It's for the court mage selection exam. We need a piece of ancient root to restore Merlin's portrait in the gallery.
say:12:1610532012:1.source_cn: 是因为这次宫廷魔法师选拔的试题。我们需要它的古老根须为...
say:12:1610532012:1.male: It's for the court mage selection exam. We need a piece of ancient root to restore Merlin's portrait in the gallery.
say:12:1610532012:1.female: It's for the court mage selection exam. We need a piece of ancient root to restore Merlin's portrait in the gallery.

say:13:1610532013:1.text: Hmph. Typical. Court mages and their insufferable little tests. Always dressing vanity up as virtue. Well, you have what you came for. Now go.

choice_prompt:15:1610532013.text: Hmph. Typical. Court mages and their insufferable little tests. Always dressing vanity up as virtue. Well, you have what you came for. Now go.
